Show Still in Love (Casual Wear)
(...Ah. At the very least... I don't want to become a burden to you.)

However, that is strictly in terms of training.
I still know very little about her outside of running.

...Ngh, no, not at all...
――Haa... I'm all right.

Ah... I-I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
And thank you... for matching your eating pace to mine...
Ah, yes! Here you go.

Even though we had no particular topic to discuss, there was no awkwardness,
only a gentle tranquility filling the air.

She never lost control once.
It would be fair to call her stable.

Still in Love brings food to her mouth, chewing slowly as if savoring each bite.
It has already been an hour since we started eating.

To support her going forward,
I ought to learn more about her as her Trainer.

I watched for a while, but the staff seemed
not to notice Still in Love's presence at all.

N-No, not at all. You could never be a bother.
...Because just being like this...

Eh, ah... I-I'm sorry...
...Ngh, I'm just not used to this kind of thing...
...Your voice, your presence, always...

It's gotten cold, hasn't it?
I'm... such a slow eater...

...Yes, ...
I've had a wonderful time.
Like this, even more――ahh, more, so much more――

...I just... seem to be... nervous.
Please don't mind me...

Some time has passed since signing a contract with Still in Love.
Training has been progressing smoothly.

My reflection shows in Still in Love's eyes.
"That girl" remains inside her as always, but――

Y-Yes...
...I'm sorry...

Welcome!
Combo meals are a great deal~! Welcome!
(So that I can... stay by your side forever...)

Fries will be ready shortly~
Ah. Takeout customers, please step over here――

...Trainer.
Today, as well.
U-Um... excuse me...

(...Such a kind person. Always staying close to me,
and accepting... every part of me...)

(Is it really all right... for me to receive so much happiness?
I wonder... if I'm pushing you too hard...)

...What a lovely breeze.
The rustling leaves are soothing too, aren't they?
Um, excuse me. I'd like to order――

I couldn't tell what her whisper, almost dissolving into the air, was saying.
Without prying, I quietly walk through the park with Still in Love.

To be invited out by you, Trainer...
I never imagined it... Um, I'm... honored.

Would you like something to eat, Trainer?
...I'll go buy it, so please save our seats.
